claims.quote: The falcate chameleon catfish, Acrochordonichthys gyrinus, is an akysid catfish known only from the Yom River, Chao Phraya basin, northern Thailand.
Described and known only from the Yom River in Phitsanulok Province, northern Thailand, the major tributary of the Nan River within the upper Chao Phraya drainage basin.
